title.narrative: RCM Certificates are accepted by ICGLR Member States, private sector companies and international mechanisms, such as RMI, as proof of responsible mineral sourcing.

description.narrative: RCM Certificates are accepted by ICGLR Member States, private sector companies and international mechanisms, such as RMI, as proof of responsible mineral sourcing.

comment.narrative: RCM certificates are accepted by all ICGLR Member States even if not all of them are issuing them. Transit countries like Kenya have requested support in setting up regulations for transiting mineral lots bearing ICGLR certificates. Private sector companies are equally accepting the certificates which is shown by the high numbers of ICGLR Audits requested by mineral exporters. Negotiations and exchanges with international actors like EPRM and RMI are ongoing to find common ground and demonstrate the reliability of the RCM and its alignment with the OECD guidance. One of the exporters ATM Ltd based in Tanzania got approval from their downstream buyer that they would accept their materials if they were audited by the ICGLR thus ATM Ltd was audited in August 2021. Progress is therefore stated at 67 23.
